message: Ever tried to navigate a blackout with just a flashlight and a questionable snack stash? 😅 It's a comedy of errors waiting to happen! I found a great resource that covers how to prepare for those unexpected power outages, so you can avoid the chaos and find the humor in it instead. Being ready means more time for fun (and less time fumbling around in the dark)! What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during a blackout?
